plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and diversifying holdings. Expect steady, low-drawdown performance.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Buy CRCL at 4% to add a strong risk/reward setup to the portfolio.
Buy SLB at 4% to diversify into another high-scoring scanner setup.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month growth, prioritizing risk management. It reduces leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech and new high-scoring setups. Expect moderate drawdowns with growth potential.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL and SPAL, increasing each to 6% to lean into leveraged ETFs.
Buy CRCL at 6% and SLB at 6% to concentrate in the highest-scoring scanner setups.
This plan uses leverage and concentration to target aggressive growth.
Strict stop discipline is crucial for managing increased risk.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth by stretching into leveraged ETFs and concentrating in high-scoring setups. This approach significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can incur substantial losses quickly without strict stop discipline.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions and low drawdown. It rotates into income-focused ETFs and broad index funds, cutting high-beta names. Remember, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
